install:
set -euo pipefail
sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true
grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
if ! command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq shellcheck; fi
if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker image inspect ghcr.io/realm/swiftlint:latest >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker pull -q ghcr.io/realm/swiftlint:latest; if ! command -v swiftlint >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(command -v swiftlint)" = "$HOME/.local/bin/swiftlint" ]; then printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -euo pipefail\nexec docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/code" -w /code ghcr.io/realm/swiftlint:latest "$@"\n' > "$HOME/.local/bin/swiftlint" && chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/swiftlint"; fi; fi
if ! command -v pre-commit >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v pip3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then pip3 install --quiet pre-commit; fi
if [ -f .pre-commit-config.yaml ] && command -v pre-commit >/dev/null 2>&1; then pre-commit install-hooks >/dev/null; fi
if [ -f docs/Gemfile ] && command -v bundle >/dev/null 2>&1; then bundle config set --global path "$HOME/.local/share/bundle" && (cd docs && BUNDLE_FROZEN=true BUNDLE_PATH="$HOME/.local/share/bundle" bundle check >/dev/null 2>&1 || BUNDLE_FROZEN=true BUNDLE_PATH="$HOME/.local/share/bundle" bundle install --quiet); fi
